passages.note: Bill overview page names Gress as prime sponsor of HB2635 but prints no operative text.

passages.provision_quote: Sales of safe firearm storage devices.
passages.note: The operative sections create a transaction privilege and use tax exemption for storage devices; they say nothing about which firearms may be owned, bought or carried.
Third-reading vote page shows Gress voting Y with no members voting No.

rows.reasoning: The only instrument on file, HB2635 (2025), is a tax exemption for "Sales of safe firearm storage devices." — a rule about how guns are stored, which does not speak to whether the law should "Ban semi-automatic assault-style weapons", "require universal background checks on every sale", "Add no new restrictions" or "Repeal major gun restrictions". Its prime sponsorship and the 57-0 vote are therefore adjacent on this ladder, and the vote is near-unanimous besides. No passage survives V2, so no rung is evidenced.
